articles.title: Russia says it freed American Stephen Hubbard, 74, as Trump envoy meets with Putin - NBC News
articles.description: Russia has released retired American teacher Stephen Hubbard, 74, the latest sign of warmer ties between the two countries as Washington pressures Kyiv to agree to a deal to end Moscow’s war.
